reworkBoundary.reason: AlembicCore runtime build artifacts still include the deleted 012_plans migration and PlanRepository, causing a fresh runtime DB to create the forbidden plans table.

Provide rg evidence over AlembicCore/src and AlembicCore/dist showing no production 012_plans/PlanRepository/plans table artifacts.
Provide a focused DB-open verification that a fresh runtime DB no longer applies 012_plans and has no plans table.
nonGoals: Do not change the already verified alembic_plan draft/confirm output shape unless the Core repair requires an integration adjustment.

decision.reason: P5 strict DB hard gate failed: a fresh BiliDili runtime DB applied 012_plans and created the forbidden plans table from AlembicCore dist artifacts.
